subject: english
question:
Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose 'No error'.

Neither of her cousins is readily to try their luck in this game.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"readily to try their" i**s incorrect.
 
• The correct phrase should be **"ready to try their"** as "**ready**" is the appropriate adjective to use here.

Therefore, the correct answer is **4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Neither of her cousins is ready to try their luck in this game."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **2: "Neither of her cousins is"** – This part of the sentence is correct and does not require any changes. "Neither" is singular and takes a singular verb ("is").
 
• **3: "luck in this game."** – This part of the sentence is correct and does not require any changes.
